description: INPUT MODE LOCK (owner report 2026-07-27): the game used to follow whatever device was touched LAST, so on a Steam Deck a trackpad/back-paddle press (which arrives as mouse or keyboard input) flipped the whole UI between the controller and mouse/keyboard presentations mid-game — and because the pad text boost multiplies the canvas content scale, the screen visibly resized. This scenario first reproduces that flip-flop under the legacy 'dynamic' policy, then proves the new locked policies: with 'pad' selected a key press and a mouse motion no longer steal the mode, with 'kbm' selected a joypad button no longer steals it, and 'auto' resolves the mode from the platform (Steam Deck -> controller, PC/browser -> mouse & keyboard). The switch itself is the player-facing Settings › Controller › Input Mode dropdown, driven here through the real menu.

steps.script:
var ev = InputEventMouseMotion.new()
ev.relative = Vector2(400, 400)
ev.position = Vector2(900, 500)
Input.parse_input_event(ev)
return true

var m = tree.root.find_children("SettingsMenu", "", true, false)[0]
return [m._tab_containers[4].visible, str(m._input_mode_dropdown.selected), m._input_mode_dropdown.get_item_text(1), m._input_mode_status_label.text]
equals: Currently using: Controller / Steam Deck (locked by you)

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.find_children("SettingsMenu", "", true, false)[0]
m._input_mode_dropdown.select(2)
m._input_mode_dropdown.item_selected.emit(2)
return [SettingsService.input_mode_policy, InputDeviceManager.mode_policy, InputDeviceManager.is_pad_active(), m._input_mode_status_label.text]
equals: Currently using: Mouse & Keyboard (locked by you)

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.find_children("SettingsMenu", "", true, false)[0]
m._input_mode_dropdown.select(0)
m._input_mode_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
return [SettingsService.input_mode_policy, InputDeviceManager.mode_policy, InputDeviceManager.detected_platform != ""]

var m = tree.root.find_children("SettingsMenu", "", true, false)[0]
m._input_mode_dropdown.select(3)
m._input_mode_dropdown.item_selected.emit(3)
return [InputDeviceManager.mode_policy, InputDeviceManager.is_mode_locked()]
